method.selection: First eight review-bearing entries returned per app; all available when fewer than eight. No star filtering. Checkride.bot returned zero textual entries.
method.coding: One author manually read and coded every selected review. Multiple themes allowed. Stars are retained but never converted automatically into sentiment. Chinese/Spanish entries were paraphrased into English; translations have not been independently checked.
limitations: Small purposive app sample and short recent-review slice; not random, representative, verified-purchase, or market-share evidence.
Dates span different periods because app review volumes differ; apps get equal eight-entry samples regardless of rating volume.
Themes mix praise, complaints, and requests; a theme count is not a satisfaction statistic.
Self-reported defects, subscriptions, outcomes, accusations, and device claims were not independently reproduced or adjudicated.
Vague praise and conflicting stars/text are retained as low_information; no demand inferred.
Featured App Store reviews and two web discussions are separate qualitative context, not part of the 120-count sample.
No reviewers were contacted, identified, or profiled; no handles or full review bodies are published.
Feed content/order can change, and numeric Apple metadata can differ from cached product pages.
